# Adding lines
<center>
![](/images/lines_black.png){style="width:150px; background: white; border-radius:5px; border: 5px white solid"}
</center>

This plot looks decent but you normally want more than one line in a line graph. Thankfully we can do this with the __function__ `lines()`. We can add the other three states to the line graph like below:

__Tip__: Remember to use tab completion to auto fill __function__, __variable__, and column names as well as for __function__ options.

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
lines(y = bee_colonies_df$Montana, x = bee_colonies_df$time_point)
lines(y = bee_colonies_df$`New Mexico`, x = bee_colonies_df$time_point)
lines(y = bee_colonies_df$Pennsylvania, x = bee_colonies_df$time_point)
```
:::
